responsibility: This definition module declares the system-level heap allocator interface used internally by gm2 runtime components. It belongs to the low-level storage backend layer and exports ALLOCATE, DEALLOCATE, REALLOCATE, Available, and Init on raw ADDRESS values, separating the internal allocator services from the public Storage wrapper that applications import.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface half of the SysStorage pair, exposing the raw ADDRESS allocator entry points ALLOCATE, DEALLOCATE, REALLOCATE, Available, and Init; SysStorage.mod is the backend that actually binds those operations to libc allocation and debugging behavior.
